module: GE extension `core_funstuff`: "fun" actions of the sandbox mode radial menu: force field, vehicle boosts and flings, destruction (break, deflate, ignite, explode), opening hoods/doors, fuel level, random colors and vehicle, random route. The exported functions act on player vehicle 0 and return an instruction for the radial menu ({'hide'} or {'reload'}). registerFunstuffActions registers the entries in core_quickAccess.
usage:
extensions.load('core_funstuff')
core_funstuff.boost()            -- +25 m/s in the vehicle's direction
core_funstuff.flingUpward()      -- +15 m/s upwards
core_funstuff.igniteVehicle()
notes: Fling values (applyFling, velocities added to the vehicle's cluster via applyClusterVelocityScaleAdd): flingUpward +15 m/s in z, flingDownward -15 m/s, boost +25 m/s along the vehicle's direction, boostBackwards -25 m/s. The effect is reduced linearly when the vehicle's speed in the fling direction exceeds 200 km/h (55.6 m/s) and cancelled at 450 km/h (125 m/s).
Return: each action returns {'hide'} (close the radial menu) or {'reload'} (reload the menu entries): value expected by core_quickAccess; no effect when called by script.

Several functions have no check: breakAllBreakgroups, breakHinges, deflateTires, deflateRandomTire, igniteVehicle, extinguishVehicle call getPlayerVehicle(0):queueLuaCommand(...) directly and cause a Lua error if there is no player vehicle. The boost/fling functions do check that the vehicle exists.

explodeVehicle: creates a repulsive 'planet' (obj:setPlanets({x,y,z,radius 5,mass})) under the vehicle with a mass of -3e13 * size/3 (size = largest half-dimension of the bounding box), triggers fire.explodeVehicle and beamstate.breakAllBreakgroups, then removes the planet after 0.2 s of simulation time (the comment says "1 second"). The command is sent to all objects (be:queueAllObjectLua), so all vehicles are subject to the force.
Not exported (internal to the menu entries): randomizeColors, randomVehicle, randomRoute (3000 to 8000 m, checkpoints every 300 m, 50 % dirt / 50 % asphalt ratio), setFuelLevel(level 0..1).

Menu entries are hidden if the corresponding action is blocked by core_input_actionFilter (funBreak, funHinges, funTires, funFire, funExtinguish, funBoom, forceField, funFling, funFlingDownward, funBoost, funBoostBackwards, latchesOpen, latchesClose, parts_selector, vehicle_selector, toggleBigMap).

Inconsistencies: the `entries` parameter of registerFunstuffActions is unused; the function registers three menu levels (/root/sandbox/funStuff/, .../destruction/, .../forces/, .../other/) and can create duplicates if called several times.

toggleForceField.desc: Cycles the force field through three states: inactive -> repulsion (multiplier 1) -> attraction (multiplier -0.5) -> inactive.

flingUpward.desc: Throws the player vehicle upwards at 15 m/s (reduced if it is already rising fast).

flingDownward.desc: Throws the player vehicle downwards at 15 m/s.

boost.desc: Adds 25 m/s to the player vehicle in its forward direction.

boostBackwards.desc: Adds 25 m/s to the player vehicle backwards.

breakAllBreakgroups.desc: Breaks all breakgroups of the player vehicle (beamstate.breakAllBreakgroups). Error if there is no vehicle.

breakHinges.desc: Breaks the hinges of the player vehicle (beamstate.breakHinges).

deflateTires.desc: Deflates all tires of the player vehicle (beamstate.deflateTires).

igniteVehicle.desc: Sets the player vehicle on fire (fire.igniteVehicle).

extinguishVehicle.desc: Extinguishes the fire of the player vehicle (fire.extinguishVehicle).

explodeVehicle.desc: Explodes the player vehicle (see notes: temporary repulsive planet + fire.explodeVehicle + breaking all breakgroups). Runs in a core_jobsystem job.

returns.desc: {'hide'}; nil if there is no player vehicle.

openLatches.desc: Opens all latches (doors, hood, trunk) of the player vehicle via core_vehicleBridge.executeAction(…, 'latchesOpen').

closeLatches.desc: Closes all latches of the player vehicle via the 'latchesClose' action.

registerFunstuffActions.desc: Registers in core_quickAccess the radial menu levels '/root/sandbox/funStuff/' (home + Destruction, Forces, Other submenus) and their entries, respecting the actions blocked by core_input_actionFilter.
